data.hypothesis: Testing a matching 64-thread CTA and 64-source tile reduces shared-memory use and work per CTA versus the measured 128/128 parent. This may improve occupancy, but it also halves source reuse and increases CTA count; only the official timing can determine the net effect.
data.notes: The existing kernel stages one bounded source tile, synchronizes around its reuse, excludes self-interactions, and writes each active target once. Its block-sized tile follows the new launch configuration. No performance result is claimed.
transformations: Set block and items_per_block to 64 so each CTA processes 64 targets and stages 64 sources per iteration.
Set shared_memory_bytes to 1024 bytes, matching the existing 16-byte SourceParticle tile of 64 entries.
Keep the kernel unchanged so its existing partial-tile bounds, barriers, self-interaction exclusion, and output coverage apply to the new launch size.
